requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area.
Student residence requires schools and universities nearby. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) because the need is essential for this project type.
User prefers an energy class of C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through C.

output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, energy_class among A1–A4, B, C, and education score >= 75. Location constraint is a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using latitude/longitude, and results are sorted by distance to that point.
